pricing.bulk_thresholds: Ascending quantity thresholds for the two nonzero bulk discounts (array of integers).
pricing.bulk_percentages: Bulk percentage at each threshold, in the same order (array).
pricing.member_percentages: Membership discount percentages for membership values 0, 1, 2 (array).
pricing.coupon1_minimum: Minimum amount used for coupon 1 eligibility (integer).
pricing.tax_rounding: Tax rounding rule: floor, nearest, or ceil (string).

record.magic: First byte of every encoded record (integer).
record.sequence_endian: Sequence field byte order: little or big (string).
record.payload_length_offset: Zero-based byte offset of the payload length (integer).
record.checksum_initial: Initial checksum accumulator before processing the record (integer).
record.checksum_rotation: Left rotation distance of the 16-bit checksum accumulator per byte (integer).
record.checksum_endian: Stored checksum byte order: little or big (string).

session.hold_lifetime: Lifetime of a newly created hold in ticks (integer).
session.expiry_inclusive: Does a hold expire when clock equals its deadline? (boolean).
session.duplicate_replaces: Does a duplicate HOLD replace the existing hold? (boolean).
session.buy_returns_stock: Does BUY return held units to available stock? (boolean).
session.tick_counts: Does TICK report expired holds or expired units? Answer holds or units.
